# Sunesis

> Sunesis is a Slovenian enterprise software engineering and consulting company specializing in enterprise AgenticAI, cloud-native platforms, API ecosystems, and DevOps.

Sunesis designs, builds, integrates, and operates secure, scalable, and business-critical software systems. It is also the creator and owner of the Kumuluz platform family (KumuluzAI, Kumuluz API, KumuluzEE).

## AI & Agent Resources
- [Research & Navigation Guide](https://sunesis.si/agents.md): Public research guide for AI agents evaluating Sunesis capabilities, architecture, and evidence.
- [Company Overview (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/company.md): Clean Markdown summary of identity, leadership, service offerings, and Sunesis vs. Kumuluz.
- [Enterprise AgenticAI (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/agentic-ai.md): Deep dive into enterprise multi-agent orchestration, KumuluzAI platform, and governance.
- [Cloud-native & Edge (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/cloud-native.md): Distributed systems, Kubernetes/OpenShift, event streaming, and KumuluzEE heritage.
- [API Ecosystems & Integrations (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/api-ecosystems.md): Enterprise API governance, Business APIs, and MCP / agent tool integration.
- [DevOps & Platform Engineering (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/devops.md): GitOps, IaC, DevSecOps, and platform engineering for production resilience.
- [Selected Enterprise Work (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/selected-work.md): Production references: AgenticAI Platform (Zavarovalniška skupina Sava), RikoAI, SI-GEOS (SURS), NLB Klik, KYC — NLB, Flare, INATrace, CUPID, eSpis and iK (Supreme Court), EPUS (Plinovodi), Akrapovič Website, Akrapovič Business Portal, Inorma (Zavarovalniška skupina Sava) and Energetika Moj utrip.
- [Research & Open Source (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/research-open-source.md): Linux Foundation projects (INATrace, CUPID) and European Horizon Europe initiatives.
- [Awards & Recognition (Markdown)](https://sunesis.si/ai/awards.md): European Commission Seal of Excellence, Java Duke's Choice Award (KumuluzEE), EuroCloud Award, GZS innovation award and Slovenian Start:up of the Year finalist.

## Core Capabilities (Web Pages)
- [Enterprise AgenticAI](https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/agentic-ai/): Governed AI agents, assistants, tool use, and enterprise orchestration on KumuluzAI.
- [Digital Solutions Development](https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/digital-solutions/): End-to-end custom enterprise applications, portals, and system integrations.
- [API Ecosystems & Integrations](https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/api-ecosystems-integrations/): Strategic API governance, Kumuluz API, and partner integration architectures.
- [Cloud-native & Edge Architectures](https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/cloud-native-edge/): Kubernetes, OpenShift, microservices, and edge computing.
- [DevOps & Platform Engineering](https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/devops-platform-engineering/): GitOps delivery pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and platform reliability.
